See also Section 5.053. SECTION 9.02: APPLICATION The R-1.5 standards are intended to be applied to lands recommended on the adopted Berlin Township Comprehensive Plan for densities of a maximum of 1.5 units per net developable area. Such R-1.5 designation requires rezoning to PRD, which is a legislative act subject to referendum. Centralized water and sanitary sewer service are a requirement of a PRD with these standards.
